using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Sample;

public class Box<T> where T : class, IShape, new()
{
	public class Nested<U>
	{
		public Dictionary<T, U> Table;
	}

	public T Item;

	public List<KeyValuePair<string, T[]>> History = new List<KeyValuePair<string, T[]>>();

	public TResult Map<TResult>(Func<T, TResult> f) where TResult : struct
	{
		return f(Item);
	}
}
